plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used; the alternate fully-online map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. Per the map's note, ECON C2001 and ECON C2002 may be taken in any order. Prerequisite transcribed from the official course descriptions: ACCT 102 requires ACCT 101. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: Introduction to Statistics
courses.choice_note: Select one of STAT C1000 / STAT C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 2 slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). STAT C1000 - Introduction to Statistics; STAT C1000H - Introduction to Statistics Honors.

courses.title: Introduction to Business
courses.choice_note: Select one of MGMT 101 / MGMT 208 per the official map (marked M). MGMT 101 - Introduction to Business; MGMT 208 - Business Communications (prerequisite: ENGL C1000; satisfies the business communications component for the AS-T).

courses.title: Principles of Microeconomics
courses.choice_note: Select one of ECON C2001 / ECON C2001H per the official map (marked M). The map notes ECON C2001 and ECON C2002 may be taken in any order. ECON C2001 - Principles of Microeconomics; ECON C2001H - Principles of Microeconomics Honors.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5B - Biological Science
courses.choice_note: Choose one Biological Science from the official map's Cal-GETC 5B list (labs marked * in the official list).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 1B - Critical Thinking and Composition
courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's Cal-GETC 1B (Critical Thinking and Composition) list: ENGL C1001, 1001H / PHIL 110, 110H.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 3A - Arts
courses.choice_note: Choose one Arts course from the official map's Cal-GETC 3A list.

courses.title: American Government and Politics
courses.choice_note: Select one of POLS C1000 / POLS C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 4 slot. POLS C1000 - American Government and Politics; POLS C1000H - American Government and Politics Honors.

courses.title: Financial Accounting
courses.choice_note: Select one of ACCT 101 / ACCT 101H per the official map (marked M). ACCT 101 - Financial Accounting; ACCT 101H - Financial Accounting Honors (prerequisite: ENGL C1000).

courses.title: US History (Cal-GETC 3B)
courses.choice_note: Choose one U.S. History course per the official map (CSU American Institutions requirement).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 1C - Oral Communication
courses.choice_note: Select one of COMM C1000 / COMM C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 1C (Oral Communication) slot. The map notes: if Areas 6 and 1C not taken, the student will need additional 2.5 UC units.

courses.title: Principles of Macroeconomics
courses.choice_note: Select one of ECON C2002 / ECON C2002H per the official map (marked M). The map notes ECON C2001 and ECON C2002 may be taken in any order. ECON C2002 - Principles of Macroeconomics; ECON C2002H - Principles of Macroeconomics Honors.

courses.title: Managerial Accounting
courses.choice_note: Select one of ACCT 102 / ACCT 102H per the official map (marked M). Official prerequisite: ACCT 101 or ACCT 101H (the 3rd-semester choice slot is the in-plan prerequisite; first-option ACCT 101 shown). ACCT 102 - Managerial Accounting; ACCT 102H - Managerial Accounting Honors (prerequisite: ACCT 101 or 101H, ENGL C1000).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5A - Physical Science
courses.choice_note: Choose one Physical Science from the official map's Cal-GETC 5A list (labs marked * in the official list).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5C - Laboratory
courses.choice_note: Choose one Laboratory course per the official map's Cal-GETC 5C list (take if a lab has not been completed in Cal-GETC 5A or 5B).

courses.title: UC/CSU Elective
courses.choice_note: Select a course that transfers to UC; see a counselor.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 6 - Ethnic Studies
courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's Cal-GETC 6 (Ethnic Studies) requirement: CHST 101 / EGSS 110.

courses.title: UC/CSU Elective
courses.choice_note: Select a course that transfers to UC; see a counselor.
